name: Masonry-TS-TW
blurb: Responsive masonry grid with entry animations and scale-on-hover effects.
description: Arranges images in columns that reflow on resize. Entry animations stagger items from a direction with optional blur fade. Hover scales items and can blend a gradient overlay.
use_when: Showcasing a portfolio or product gallery with varied aspect ratios and pronounced visual entry.
avoid_when: Static galleries or when images must be non-interactive. Requires a sized container and GSAP animations.
a11y: Images render as background images, not img tags. Items are clickable but offer no keyboard interaction. No focus styles or prefers-reduced-motion support.
